title: BLF: Fix use of Buffer
description:
Don't call `ws_buffer_assure_space` before `ws_buffer_append`, except if we need to append more than once.

Correct instances where `blf_read_bytes` was copying to the start of the buffer instead of the end.

notes.body: These should probably be done by `ws_buffer_increase_length(&params->rec->data, <length>)`.

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/18703/diffs?diff_id=1229146063&start_sha=d00e2c5381f660436d49da6263e14775bd5acea7#4edaab23888743307322f501fbaef9f54209f5e5_1532_1534)
Given that the `blf_read_bytes()` call is reading into the `Buffer`, is some call done earlier (outside the routine) that ensures that there's sufficient space in the buffer?

commits_data.message:
BLF: Fix use of Buffer

Don't call `ws_buffer_assure_space` before `ws_buffer_append`, except if we need to append more than once.
Correct instances where `blf_read_bytes` was copying to the start of the buffer instead of the end.
Use `ws_buffer_increase_length` when needed.
